prompt: Build Mahoraga (Eight-Handled Sword Divergent Sila Divine General Mahoraga) from Jujutsu Kaisen — a massive armored shikigami demon. Its single most iconic feature is the enormous DHARMA WHEEL mounted horizontally on top of its head (a large flat circular wheel/ring with spokes and segments, like a Buddhist dharma chakra). Below the wheel is a humanoid armored body: a beastly head with a snarling face, broad armored shoulders and chest plates, muscular arms, and a powerful stance. The body is armored plating. Use STONE and COBBLE for the gray armored body and the wheel, OAK_LOG for darker plating accents and the wheel's spokes, SAND/PLANKS for bone-white tusks and the wheel's rim highlights, BRICK for glowing red eyes and accents. The giant wheel on the head is the unmistakable identifier — make it large, clearly circular with internal spokes/segments, sitting flat on top of the head. Face it toward the viewer. Make it imposing and unmistakably Mahoraga.
